create_completion: create a POST endpoint at /v1/completions that handles OpenAI-style text completion requests with streaming support
build_restapi_router: build a FastAPI router that attaches OpenAI-compatible completion endpoints to an application
test_create_completion: test the create_completion endpoint handles CompletionRequest and returns JSON or streaming responses
review_attach_router: review the attach_router function that mounts the completion router onto a FastAPI app
summarize_completion: summarize the completion dependency function that retrieves the OpenAIServingCompletion handler from request state
